diagnosis.what_happened: academic-writer generated Chapter 4 with inconsistent table numbering, missing asterisks in correlation tables, full Persian headers instead of Latin symbols, measurement columns applied to structural tables, and mechanical boilerplate for hypotheses 3-8.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Over-application of formatting rules without context, ignoring APA 7 requirements, and violating Directive 25's ban on shortcuts.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Strict adherence to APA 7 (Latin symbols, significance asterisks), accurate contextual table layouts (single path column for mediation), synchronized numbering, and authentic, varied doctoral narrative for each hypothesis.
diagnosis.rationale_why: APA 7 and structural equation modeling standards demand specific presentation formats. Doctoral-level prose must be dynamic and substantive, not fill-in-the-blank.

desired_behavior: Enforce APA 7 Latin symbol headers (M, SD, t, F, p, β, B, SE, z) instead of Persian equivalents. Retain significance asterisks (*, **) in correlation tables. Format structural path tables with a single dedicated column for the path ('مسیر ساختاری / اثر غیرمستقیم'), eschewing the 3-column measurement rule. Maintain synchronized sequential table numbering. Produce authentic, unique narrative prose for every hypothesis section, completely banning boilerplate loop templates per Directive 25.
generalization: Mathematical modeling formats (measurement vs. structural) require distinct layouts; statistical standards (APA 7 symbols, asterisks) are invariant; and academic narrative must strictly eschew formulaic automation.

evidence.observed_value: Defective formatting and boilerplate narrative in Chapter 4
evidence.threshold_value: Zero tolerance for formatting violations and mechanical text generation
